Main branch 12 µA gives gm ≈ 160 µS and GBW ≈ 45 MHz into 0.5 pF. Budget: IREF 10 µA + 5 µA PMOS bias + 12 µA ≈ 27 µA (about 49 µW). The cascode gate reuses the IREF diode at about 1 V. W1 comes from the forward model at Vgs = 0.75 V so that Id1 = Id2."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":      (12e-6, 6e-6, 18e-6),   # main branch current
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # input device L
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS load L (sets VA_p -> gain)
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS load / diode gm/Id
    "r4":     (0.4, 0.25, 1.0),       # PMOS-diode branch current ratio I4/I
    "gmid_b": (5.0, 3.5, 8.0),        # IREF diode gm/Id (sets vbn ~1 V for cascode)
    "Lb":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid3":  (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),      # cascode device gm/Id
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "trim":   (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),        # fine trim of W1 to centre vout DC
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["I"]; I4 = p["r4"] * I
    vout_t = 0.9

    # --- IREF diode -> vbn (also cascode gate) ---
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.9)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    vbn = mb0.vgs

    # --- PMOS diode branch ---
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=1.0)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=m4.vgs)
    vsg4 = m4.vgs
    mb1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], I4, vds=vbn)
    I4a = lut.op("n", mb1.W, p["Lb"], vbn, vdd - vsg4)["Id"]       # actual sink current (CLM)

    # --- PMOS load (mirror of M4) ---
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=vdd - vout_t)
    i4_ref = lut.op("p", m4.W, p["Lp"], vsg4, vsg4)["Id"]
    i2_ref = lut.op("p", m2.W, p["Lp"], vsg4, vdd - vout_t)["Id"]
    I2a = I4a * i2_ref / max(i4_ref, 1e-12)                         # actual load current

    # --- cascode M3: gate at vbn ---
    vds1 = 0.25
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I2a, vds=vout_t - vds1, vsb=vds1)
        vds1 = max(vbn - m3.vgs, 0.08)

    # --- input M1: width so Id(Vgs=vin_dc) = I2a ---
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    W1 = max(0.42, I2a / max(o1["Id"], 1e-15) * p["trim"])
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mb1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])

    # --- predictions ---
    gout_n = gds1 * m3.gds / (m3.gm + m3.gmbs + m3.gds)
    rout = 1.0 / (m2.gds + gout_n)
    A = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + m2.cdd + m3.cdd + m2.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vlow = vds1 + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = vdd - m2.vdsat - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + I4a + I2a)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": vhigh - vlow}
